race.description: Hops & Hooves Festival Sat 26 Sept Hcp (Bm50)
race.comment: STAR EMPIRE (2) jumped a $31 chance first-up at this track and was only 1.1L off the winner when leading. This shapes as a perfect race for him off the inside alley and Ellison's claim is a big tick. He's suited by the slight rise in trip and he can get back to winning ways now. WOLF ISLAND (3) has been tackling stronger races throughout his career and is racing well without winning. He's likely to get back from the wide draw, though if the pace is on up front then he'll be storming home. MERCHANT REIGN (1) landed a good plunge here last time out when scoring by 0.9L in an all-the-way win over 1080m. This shapes a little differently from a wide barrier, but he has to be respected on the back of a strong last start victory. SANZENO (10) can feature now at his peak and back in grade. EYE FOR STYLE (6) is third-up now and is not to be discounted.
